description: Efficient seismic fragility functions through sequential selection is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Francisco Pena, Purdue University (purdue.edu). Fragility functions enable the assessment of a structural system for a given hazard scenario. Specifically, the fragility function provides the probability of an undesirable structural state conditioned on the occurrence of a specific hazard level. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-dfgw-wh91. Keywords: Seismic Fragility Analysis; Sequential Selection of Experiments; Bayesian Inference; Sequential Monte Carlo. Published 2020-04-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
